Author: SaMo (PvpStats) / FLStatsPlus contributors
Name: FLStats Plus (Test)
Punchline: TEST BUILD of FLStats Plus for trying UI changes. Uses its own data and /flpt commands.
Description: Fork of PvP Tracker (PvpStats) by SaMo. Records Crystalline Conflict, Frontline and Rival Wings match history and stats, adds a Frontline personal combat log (every skill you hit with and every hit you took) and exports matches and history to self-contained HTML reports, JSON and CSV.
